_readme: All simulated AI output for the Liaison prototype lives here. Replace each section with a real AI call later. Sections: trip (Step 1->2), profile (Step 3), itinerary + revisions (Step 4).

trip.exampleInput: I am going on a 10 day trip to Italy across Venice, Florence, and Naples with my mom, dad, and 2 sisters. We're hoping to keep the budget below $4,000 per person including flights. We are targeting early February.

summaryItaly.blurb: A 10-day Italian circuit from the canals of Venice to Renaissance Florence and ending in Naples, planned for a multigenerational family on a $4,000 per-person budget.

summaryFallback.blurb: (Simulated) The AI would summarize your trip here. Try the Italy example for the full happy path.

examples.organizer: I'm 34 and I love food markets, art museums and local history. I don't have any allergies. I can walk a lot. My budget is $4,000 including flights.
examples.dad: I like relaxing vacations. I don't eat pork or red meats. I don't drink alcohol. I can walk maybe 30 minutes before I need to rest.
examples.sister: I enjoy cultural and historical sites. I don't enjoy nightlife too much. I like nature as well. I don't eat pork or drink alcohol. I am able to walk a lot.
examples.default: I like cultural sites and good food. I'm 40. I can walk a lot. My budget is $4,000.

rules.value: Needs rest after ~{1} min of walking

ambiguities.question: You mentioned avoiding red meat. Does that include lamb and cured meats like prosciutto or salami?
No budget was mentioned. Is the group target of under $4,000 per person (flights included) OK for you?
How much walking per day is comfortable for you?

items.text: Arrive at Marco Polo Airport; water-bus transfer to Hotel Laguna
Gondola ride along the Grand Canal
Seafood dinner in Dorsoduro (pork-free, alcohol-free menu options)
St. Mark's Basilica and Doge's Palace
Vaporetto to Murano (glass workshop) and Burano
Quiet dinner near the Rialto Bridge
Gallerie dell'Accademia
3-hour walking tour of Cannaregio and Dorsoduro canals

replacements.mobility: Private water-taxi tour of the Grand Canal with seated stops (under 10 minutes of walking)
replacements.default: Private water-taxi tour of the Grand Canal with seated stops (under 10 minutes of walking)

items.text: Cicchetti dinner (non-pork, non-alcohol options)
High-speed train Venice to Florence; check in at Hotel Arno
Duomo, Baptistery and Giotto's Bell Tower
Dinner in the Oltrarno district
Uffizi Gallery
Ponte Vecchio and Palazzo Pitti
Night out in Florence's nightlife district (bars and live music)

replacements.nightlife: Sunset at Boboli Gardens followed by a quiet dinner
replacements.default: Sunset at Boboli Gardens followed by a quiet dinner

items.text: Day trip by train to Siena
Siena Cathedral and Piazza del Campo
Return to Florence; relaxed dinner
High-speed train Florence to Naples; check in at Hotel Lungomare
Spaccanapoli and the historic center
Neapolitan pizza dinner (margherita and marinara)
Hike the Mount Vesuvius crater trail (about 3 hours, steep)

replacements.mobility: Shuttle to the Vesuvius upper lot with a short 10-minute walk to the crater-rim viewpoint
replacements.default: Shuttle to the Vesuvius upper lot with a short 10-minute walk to the crater-rim viewpoint

items.text: Lunch in Ercolano and a visit to the Herculaneum ruins
Seafront dinner on the Lungomare
Pompeii archaeological site
National Archaeological Museum of Naples
Farewell family dinner
Castel dell'Ovo and harbor stroll
Transfer to Naples airport
Flight home
